description: This file defines the interface ISiloStatusOracle, which provides methods for querying and subscribing to silo status information within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods to get the current status, names, addresses, and approximate statuses of silos, as well as subscription management for silo status events.

methods.name: CurrentStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of this silo.

methods.name: SiloName
methods.description: Gets the name of this silo.

methods.name: SiloAddress
methods.description: Gets the address of this silo.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Returns an immutable array of addresses of currently active silos.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns an approximate status of a specified silo.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Returns approximate statuses for all silos, optionally only active ones.

methods.name: TryGetSiloName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the static name of a specified silo.

methods.name: IsFunctionalDirectory
methods.description: Determines if the specified silo is valid for directory operations.

methods.name: IsDeadSilo
methods.description: Checks if a specified silo is considered dead.

methods.name: SubscribeToSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to silo status events.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from silo status events.
